lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in semi-regular horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting with horizontal spot alignments to form a grid-like pattern of local maxima.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Horizontal linear feature on the upper third of the flank characterized by a high-contrast luminance gradient with a bright superior edge and shadowed inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Discrete high-luminance blobs distributed within the visible silhouette of the first dorsal fin, showing a lower spatial frequency compared to the cephalic region.

other_distinctive_markers: A high concentration of smaller, high-frequency luminance spots is visible on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin compared to the larger blobs on the primary flank.
